## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      14 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 15, 2026 - Aug 6, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _app reviewer aak_, Aug 6, 2026, 1/5: "Used it for a month and generally had a decent experience with their bikes. However, the app is very buggy, and can sometimes not end your ride properly resulting in an overcharge. I have tried contacting support multiple and they haven’t got back to me, nor have they even acknowledged receipt of my issue. I think they just hope you dont notice these charges and over time, give them more money that you dont owe them. Cancelled my subscription to them and switched back to Lime."
            2. _HL46645_, Aug 3, 2026, 1/5: "This is an objectively terrible app. It has constant issues that cannot be put into a review. It constantly lets you down and is significantly worse than competitors. This wouldn’t be an issue if it didn’t resort to buying monopolies in areas to force people into paying for its horrible service who have no other choice. It will constantly let you down and make you pay for the privilege. Awful"
            3. _Samuel5757_, Aug 5, 2026, 4/5: "I’ve had a frustrating few weeks with Forest. I bought several minute bundles that I either couldn’t use properly because the app wouldn’t let me start or end rides during the recent technical issues, and it took much longer than I’d have liked to get everything resolved. That said, I do want to give credit where it’s due. I eventually managed to get through on the live chat, and the issue was resolved. It’s a shame I had to go the extra mile to get there, as it did leave me feeling ignored for a while, but the support I received in the end was genuinely helpful. The recent technical issues have clearly been significant, and I appreciate that it’s not easy for a smaller, home-grown business to deal with problems on that scale. Communication could certainly be improved during outages, but I’m hopeful this has been a learning experience. For now, my faith in Forest has been restored. I really like the service when it’s working well, and I’m looking forward to seeing the reliability and customer support continue to improve. Keep it up!"
